varis_opening.why: Smoothest opening: steadiest loudness (10-90 s ST spread 0.9 LU vs 2.1 vd-a / 1.6 vd-b; max change 0.5 LU/s vs 1.0 / 1.4), most stable timbre (centroid std 21 Hz vs 42 / 34), no strong onsets, no clicks, no transients, pulse clarity 0.06. vd-b has events (4 strong onsets, 6 dB spectral jump at ~89 s). The original candidate is in Ab and clashes with the Varış-Derinleşme beds that follow (A/D), so the selected file is its +1 semitone varispeed copy (A major, same bass pedal as vd-a).
varis_opening.fallback_if_varispeed_rejected: el-vd-a.wav (2nd smoothest, no events, already A major; clash vs vd-b 0.12)

key_finding.summary: ElevenLabs ignored the key for 5 of 7 pieces: vd-a A major, vd-b D major, derin-a A major, imge D minor/major, kapanis G/D; v-aday Ab major (IV of Eb), derin-b Eb major. Crossfades between the two groups clash (clash index 0.35-0.42 vs 0.11-0.14 within a group).
key_finding.action: Two local 1-semitone varispeed copies bring the outliers into the A/D majority (el-v-aday.keyA, el-derin-b.keyD); originals kept. Moving the majority to Eb instead would need a tritone shift of vd-a/derin-a (rejected: audible timbre damage). Needs orchestrator decision: the resulting set is A/D-family, not E-flat.
